Marco Ruiz: Quick sync — prepping a dry-run for the joint perf/W benchmarking with Ampere next week. Proposed window: Wed 2026-09-08 10:00-14:00 PT. Need env prep, kernel patch deploy, and telemetry hooks. Docs/runbook: https://redwood-internal.link/bench/dryrun @eng-runtime @partnerships :eyes:
Alice Chen: SGTM. Are we running q8_0 int8 variants or the fp16 path as primary? This matters for kernel tune and perf counters.
Marco Ruiz: Primary will be int8 (q8_0) for throughput/perfW profile, but we want an fp16 baseline run too. Kernel patch is in PR #4321 (eng-runtime). Summary of steps I'll use:
```
# checkout kernel branch
git fetch origin && git checkout -b perf/ampere-kernel origin/perf/ampere-kernel
# build runtime with tuning flags
make -j16 BUILD_QUANT=true KERNEL_TUNE=ampere
# deploy runtime to test pool
redwoodctl deploy --pool bench-dryrun --image runtime:ampere-tune
# run harness (example)
bench-harness run --model Llama-13B --seq 2048 --batch 8 --iters 500 --out s3://redwood-bench/dryrun/1865432100
```
Marco Ruiz: We'll run three sequence lengths (512 / 1024 / 2048) and two batch sizes (4 / 8). Please make sure the harness has the model artifact with KV-cache enabled.
Anita Patel: Telemetry note: capture per-step power via INA + nvml sample at 200ms, and tag traces with model, seqlen, batch, quant_mode. bench-bot should pull nvml stats and push telemetry bundle. Also add a metric for cache hit rate (prefix/KV).
bench-bot: Starting instrumentation hooks. Will auto-upload logs and telemetry to s3://redwood-bench/dryrun/1865432100/ and emit a summary JSON when done.
Jared Kim: FYI — infra might throttle if other jobs run. I've reserved 2 racks (rack-a, rack-b) for the window, but we need cost approval for the reserved capacity spike.
Alice Chen: Ok noted. For kernel tune: can we gate the first run on the patched GEMM microkernel? Last time we saw regression without the patch.
Marco Ruiz: Yes. Plan: smoke run (30 iters) -> check perf/w and p95 latency -> full run. If regressions > 5% vs baseline, abort and roll back kernel.
Anita Patel: Add a short checklist in the runbook for smoke validation steps (nvml sanity, power rails, perf counters ok). I'll add that now.
Jared Kim: Cost approval request sent to finance (ticket #FIN-988).
Marco Ruiz: Can everyone ack before EOD today so I can send calendar invite and share the run artifacts? If no blockers we execute dry-run Wed.
Alice Chen: Ack :thumbsup:
Anita Patel: Ack, will be on-call that slot.
Jared Kim: Ack, infra ready.
bench-bot: Uploaded initial instrumentation manifest to s3://redwood-bench/dryrun/1865432100/manifest.json
Marco Ruiz: Great — thanks all. I'll post the calendar invite and link the PR + runbook. If anything pops up ping me in this thread. :rocket:
